sources.quote: Debuff Immunity: Baron Nashor is immune to all terrain displacements and immune to all crowd control except stasis. Additionally, Baron Nashor's stats cannot be modified by any external means.
All epic monsters are CC immune, excluding stasis which is special-cased.

clientTag.scope: Client identity tag; does not establish server immunity initialization.
